answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 2435 Country: United Kingdom Title: I recently went Pakistan, me and my step mother have fallen in love with each other. we wish to marry each other as she can't live with my father any more. Also is she haram on her husband if i and her have seen each other naked. we have done everything beside i entering her vagina. she is pregnant with my fathers child. If we cannot marry in Islam. and we get married what is the punishment and what will happen. i can't live without her i wish to commit suicide. Please could you guide us on this matter as quickly as possible. could you also give a detailed reply on this matter please. Question: salaam. I recently went Pakistan, me and my step mother have fallen in love with each other. we wish to marry each other as she can't live with my father any more. Also is she haram on her husband if i and her have seen each other naked. we have done everything beside i entering her vagina. she is pregnant with my fathers child. If we cannot marry in Islam. and we get married what is the punishment and what will happen. i can't live without her i wish to commit suicide. Please could you guide us on this matter as quickly as possible. could you also give a detailed reply on this matter please. Answer ID: 2435 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1758/1554=B) It is haram to marry stepmother. You ought to distance yourself from the affair and seek repentance from Allah from these satanic act and thinking. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
